title: Ethiopian Peanut Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory Ethiopian-inspired peanut stir fry made with whisked eggs, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of peanut flavor.
instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the bell pepper and carrots and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet.
Pour in the whisked eggs and scramble them until they are cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the vegetables.
Add the peanuts and stir-fry spice and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
